Messages.Author: John M. Baker
Messages.Body:
If a vampire burns and is Possessed into play again
in the same minion phase, does the No Repeat Actions
still affect it after it comes back from the grave?

e.g. Gloria bleeds, is blocked, and is burned. Rudolpho
Possesses Gloria. Can she now bleed again this minion
phase?

John Baker

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
John M. Baker wrote:
>
> If a vampire burns and is Possessed into play again
> in the same minion phase, does the No Repeat Actions
> still affect it after it comes back from the grave?

No. (Well, yes, but it has forgotten all of the actions
it took before being burned. If it bleeds after returning
from the ash heap, it cannot bleed again that turn.)

> e.g. Gloria bleeds, is blocked, and is burned. Rudolpho
> Possesses Gloria. Can she now bleed again this minion
> phase?

Yes.
